summary: Flat kerb where cars park, backed by green strip; homes 18-20 m on both sides.

best_section.where: South kerb of Marmion Parade in front of the grassed verge and tree strip

drivers.seclusion: A tree-lined verge and gardens sit behind the kerb; houses 18-20 m across the road to the north and 13-22 m on the south side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along it; room at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street near a junction at the east end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs give 2P parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
Junction noise at the east end
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the kerb from the south and west.
